criteria: A full mock in AQA's four-paper structure: Paper 1 (a new listening-style passage read aloud by the tutor, plus a dictation), Paper 2 (a role-play, a reading-aloud text with follow-up questions, and a photo-card discussion), Paper 3 (a new reading passage with a translation into English), Paper 4 (a translation into Spanish and two pieces of extended writing)
All questions and answers in Spanish except the translation into English and the English-language questions in Paper 1 Section A
Marked against AQA-style Higher-tier criteria: communication of content, range and accuracy of language, and (for speaking) pronunciation, fluency and spontaneous interaction
exam_rubric.pass_threshold: At least 50% of the 200 marks overall and at least 40% on each of the four papers (the course's own standard; AQA boundaries vary by series).
